name: Open the public Finzanjir landing page and navigate to its purpose
description: Verifies the primary public page loads with the Finzanjir identity and the main purpose section is reachable.
steps: Confirm the purpose section is visible
expected: The Finzanjir landing page loads successfully and the purpose section is visible with four clearly separated goals.

name: Read the author and AI vision sections
description: Verifies the public page presents the author and the future AI vision without exposing private contact information.
expected: The AI purpose and author sections are visible, the author name is shown, and no phone number, email address, or residential address is displayed.

name: Use the site on a mobile viewport
description: Verifies the public page remains readable and usable on a narrow mobile viewport.
steps: Open the public Finzanjir site at a mobile viewport
Scroll through the purpose, AI, and author sections
expected: Content remains readable without horizontal overflow, and the return-to-top action moves back to the page top.

name: Confirm technical internals are intentionally absent from the public page
description: Verifies the public page stays focused on purpose, principles, future vision, and authorship.
steps: Review all visible sections of the public page
Look for detailed Case, Risk Engine, signal algorithm, phone, email, or address information
expected: The public page does not expose internal technical implementation details or private contact information.
